description: This file defines a React context provider and hooks for managing and caching user and session data within a React application. It handles data fetching, loading/error states, and provides a centralized data store for components.

methods.name: useDataContext
methods.description: Custom hook to access the shared DataContext providing user and session data.

methods.name: DataProvider
methods.description: React component that initializes and provides cached user and session data, along with refresh functions, to its children.
